A '''red dragon''' may be encountered in the [[Occult floors]] while training [[Dungeoneering]]. This monster uses a long-range [[dragonfire]] attack in addition to its regular dragonfire attack. This can prove very deadly to those without an [[Anti-dragon shield (Dungeoneering)|anti-dragon shield]] or a [[cure potion]], or for those with [[two-handed sword]]s. [[Protect from Magic|Protect from]]/[[Deflect Magic]] may also be used to avoid heavy damage from its dragonfire, but the dragon will still regularly hit in the 200s-300s.

Unlike standard [[red dragon]]s, which are weak to [[arrows]], these dragons are weak to [[stab weapons]], so those with [[spears]], [[rapier]]s, or [[dagger]]s will be at an advantage.
